 Follow Live: Pitt Football vs. Florida State
 11/13/2026 2:04:00 PM | Football
 Game Notes Watch (ESPN) Buy Tickets Share: Share: PREGAME 
 Corey Dailey will start at quarterback for Pitt against Florida State. The news came 30 minutes before kickoff, with Holden Geriner listed as a game time decision on the availability report.
 It will be the freshman's second career start. Dailey was QB1 against Boston College, going 11-for-25 for 193 yards, one touchdown and two interceptions. He opened that game with a 75-yard touchdown pass to Blue Hicks.
 On the season, Dailey is 17-for-25 for 316 yards, three touchdowns and three interceptions.
 There are also a few other changes with guys banged up. Jeremiah Warren will start at defensive tackle, Shadarian Harrison will take Shawn Lee Jr.'s place at cornerback and Damon Ferguson Jr. will be RB1.

 INJURY REPORT 
 The ACC released its availability report two hours before Friday's 7 p.m. kickoff against Florida State. Pitt's quarterback position and defensive line are both in question, and the depth will be tested. 
 OUT 
 DT Sean FitzSimmons 
FitzSimmons will miss his first game this season. He has 24 tackles, three for loss, two sacks and four quarterback hurries, making him one of the backbones of the defensive line.
 Pitt does have depth behind him in Jeremiah Warren , Ty Yuhas and Lincoln Hoke , though that gets dicey with Eliyt Nairne also a game time decision. The rest of the starting defensive line is available.
 GAME TIME DECISION 
 QB Holden Geriner 
Geriner is 77-for-132 for 886 yards and four touchdowns. He took over after Mason Heintschel went down for the season and has started every game since the Virginia Tech contest except Boston College.
 If Geriner can't go, expect freshman Corey Dailey to step in. Dailey started against Boston College and is 17-for-25 for 316 yards, three touchdowns and three interceptions this season.
 RB Ja'Kyrian Turner 
Turner has played in just three games this season, with 30 carries for 3.7 yards per carry and a touchdown. He came back against Virginia Tech and North Carolina after a three-game absence, but he left the Tar Heels game early. He has been out since, missing the Boston College and Georgia Tech games.
 Pitt will keep leaning on freshman Damon Ferguson Jr. , who leads the way with 123 carries for 662 yards (73.6 per game) and six touchdowns.
 DL Eliyt Nairne 
Nairne has already missed two games this season. He is a key depth piece up front, with six tackles, 0.5 for loss and 0.5 sacks. His status matters more with FitzSimmons out.
 DB Shawn Lee Jr. 
Lee has played in all nine games this season, with 23 tackles, two for loss, one interception and three pass breakups. Fellow starter Raion Strader is available, and Pitt has depth behind Lee in Rashan Murray , Shadarian Harrison and Zion Ferguson .
 LB DeMarco Ward 
Ward is one of the linebackers Pitt leans on heavily, especially in certain special packages. He has 30 tackles, 3.5 for loss, two sacks and four quarterback hurries.
 The three starters, Jeremiah Marcelin , Braylan Lovelace and Alex Sanford, are all available. Losing Ward would thin things out even more with Cam Lindsey out for the season, so expect more snaps for Davin Brewton , Jayden Bonsu and others if needed.
 CELEBRATING THE SENIOR CLASS 
 THE SCRIPT: PITT VS. FLORIDA STATE 
 TRAILER | PITT VS. FLORIDA STATE 
 PREVIEW 
 The Pitt Panthers (6-3, 3-3 ACC) host the Florida State Seminoles (4-5, 2-4 ACC) in primetime this Friday night at 7 PM on ESPN.
 Friday's game marks Senior Night, as Pitt recognizes its seniors for their contributions to the program. The Panthers enter their final home game with a 5-1 record at Acrisure Stadium this season.
 Pitt and Florida State meet for the 13th time in a series that dates to 1971. The Panthers lead the all-time series, 7-5, following last season's 34-31 victory in Tallahassee. The ACC series is tied, 2-2.
 Pitt owns a 2-1 record against Florida State under Pat Narduzzi , earning victories in 2020 and 2025. A victory Friday would give the Panthers consecutive series wins and their first home victory over the Seminoles since 1983.
